ruling.recommended_action: Refund $1.13 to the rider as a Ryde voucher (RD-2, only the unexempt detour's extra distance) and record the RD-1 breach on the driver's file; no account flag warranted (RD-6 not met).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:57–23:01 (2.19 km vs 1.38 km optimal, +0.80 km). Driver claims AYE congestion [F9], but RD-4(a) requires a traffic-incident fact on the replaced optimal route — none exists [F13]. The AYE band-1 record [F10] is only corroborative under RD-4(b) and its window 22:39–22:57 does not cover the segment start; CET/Kent Ridge bands [F11][F12] are irrelevant. No prior rider consent to the route change under RD-5 (chat covers pickup only) [F7][F8]; no rider-requested stop under RD-3. Segment is an unexempt detour under RD-1.

rejected_claims.reason: Refund of the full $2.33 excess-distance billing is rejected: RD-2 refunds only the unexempt segment's extra distance (0.80 km × $1.41/km = $1.13); the remainder of the +1.6 km total is map-matching/route-variation residual and is not refunded.
Driver's congestion excuse rejected as an exemption: no traffic-incident fact on the optimal route [F13], and a speed-band record alone cannot exempt a segment under RD-4(b).
